messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high queue growth detected for inference pool us-west2-gpu (>=300% over 5m). autoscaler status: pending-scale, last-error=QUOTA_EXCEEDED. PagerDuty triggered for oncall.

raj (sre): seeing a ton of 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota limit reached' in the cluster autoscaler logs. scale attempts hitting GCP GPU quota for project redwood-prod-us.

maya (oncall): confirmed. queue length for batch workers jumped from 120 -> 980 in 6m. latency SLOs breached for several top-tier customers.

kevin (infra): checking GCP console now — quota for NVIDIA_T4 in us-west2 is at limit for the project. there's also a regional vCPU softlimit creeping.

raj (sre): logs snippet: ```
I0302 15:44:21.123 autoscaler.go:312] scaling up: group=gpu-pool-us-west2 target=8 current=2 reason=queue_growth
E0302 15:44:23.987 cloudquota.go:54] createInstance failed: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 123456789, quotaExceeded
```

tess (eng-ml): impact: realtime inference jobs are getting 429s or 202 accepted-but-delayed. batch jobs are stuck in pending for >20m. We need short-term mitigations: fallback to smaller model for best-effort traffic, and try routing new requests to eu-west1.

carol (product): Which customers are affected? Any enterprise SLAs at risk? Need comms sync.

raj (sre): enterprise customers on dedicated pools unaffected. A subset of hosted API users in US region are impacted — roughly 6 customers with high throughput. SLOs for free-tier are degraded too but lower priority.

maya (oncall): immediate playbook steps: 1) add annotation to autoscaler to stop further scale attempts if quota error persists, 2) enable routing-policy fallback to eu-west1 for new sessions, 3) kick off quota request with GCP support, 4) reduce model defaults for best-effort requests. I'll run 1-3 now.

kevin (infra): applying a temporary k8s patch to set maxReplicas=4 on that pool to avoid continuous failed launches and to free up scheduler churn. patch: ```
kubectl patch hpa gpu-pool-us-west2 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":4}}' --namespace=prod
```

raj (sre): also toggling prefix cache bypass for queued sessions to reduce memory pressure on existing pods.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-48921 assigned to maya (oncall).

maya (oncall): pinging GCP quota support — created case CASE-2026-0312-7890. ETA 1-2 hours per chat. cc @kevin @raj.

tess (eng-ml): rolling a model downgrade route for non-SLA traffic: default-generation-model -> 13B-mid instead of 70B-large. Making a runtime toggle in the router: ```
PATCH /route-configs/us-west2
{ "fallback_model": "13B-mid", "apply_to": "non_sla" }
```

kevin (infra): network routing change applied: new requests flagged as region-aware will attempt eu-west1 first if us-west2 returns QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE. Applied at 15:51 UTC.

carol (product): preparing customer-facing note: short blurb that we're experiencing regional capacity shortages in us-west2 causing delays; mitigation in progress and enterprise customers have dedicated fallbacks. Will post to status.redwo od.ai at 16:00 UTC after confirmation.

raj (sre): temporarily throttling low-priority tokens (rate-limit bump down) to preserve capacity for priority customers. Command: ```
/ops rate-limit set default_policy=preserve_sla priority_only=true
```

maya (oncall): customer impact summary for initial post: "Some hosted API requests from US customers may see increased latency or throttling over the next 1-3 hours while we reroute traffic and coordinate with cloud provider." Any objections?

carol (product): fine. Add note that we're implementing model fallback to reduce cost and latency for non-critical workloads.

kevin (infra): update from GCP: quota increase request acknowledged, they can provision +20 T4s but require confirmation of billing and an internal review; ETA ~90m.

tess (eng-ml): can we spin up cpu-backed inference pool as temporary fallback for small requests? Latency will be worse but avoids 429s. If someone can approve ephemeral CPU spend, I'll wire the router to send best-effort requests there.

raj (sre): approved for triage budget. spinning up cpu-pool-us-west2-small. will take ~6m to start.

maya (oncall): spun up cpu fallback, routing toggled. Monitoring queue drop now — pending jobs decreased from 980 -> 420 in 12m. latency for priority customers improving.

incident-bot: NOTE: auto-remediation marker set by maya (oncall): TEMP_QUOTA_WORKAROUND.

maya (oncall): postmortem owner: raj (sre) — will lead root cause + followups including quota dashboarding and a runbook update. I'll leave this incident to PD and hand off to raj after stabilization.

raj (sre): taking it. next steps: 1) verify GCP quota increment when available, 2) add proactive alert if quota utilization >85% for >10m, 3) evaluate pre-provision buffer for us-west2 GPU pool, 4) write customer impact timeline.

carol (product): schedule a comms follow-up with affected customers; product lead cc'ing support to prepare templates.

maya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for pager: queue growth flattened, priority SLOs restored. keeping thread open until quota confirmed.

kevin (infra): leaving notes: created CASE-2026-0312-7890, patch applied to HPA, cpu fallback active, router fallback enabled.

tess (eng-ml): notes: model fallback rollout activated at 15:53 UTC; 13B-mid handled ~60% of best-effort requests. Will monitor quality regressions and revert as needed.

raj (sre): last check: autoscaler error rate down to baseline, pending createInstance failures reduced. I'll take the handoff and convert to post-incident ticket.

incident-bot: INCIDENT PD-48921 status: MITIGATED (temporary). last update 16:06 UTC.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. handing off to raj for postmortem. I'll remain available for followups.
